name: ab-test-duration-calculator
description: Calculates how many days an A/B test must run to reach the required sample size. Returns minimum test duration in days, enforces the 14-day minimum for day-of-week coverage, and flags low-traffic scenarios.

baselineCVR.description: Current conversion rate as a percentage

mde.description: Minimum detectable effect as a relative percentage improvement

dailyVisitors.description: Average daily unique visitors to the page being tested

trafficSplit.description: Percentage of traffic allocated to the test (default 100)
